description: This source file defines the TreeFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a hierarchy of tasks and activities in an expandable list view. It handles lifecycle events, UI initialization, and rendering of task data using RecyclerView.

classes.name: TreeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that displays a hierarchical list of tasks using RecyclerView, manages ViewModel interactions, and handles UI updates.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes the view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and sets up observation for data updates.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Triggers a display refresh when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onResumeHelper
methods.description: Updates the UI with the task list when data changes.

methods.name: displayRecycler
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView to display task data.

methods.name: openTask
methods.description: Expands a specific task group in the list by simulating a click.
